about: The canonical pieces every axKit window is made of, the few types of window, and which app is which (docs/axKit/framework.md). The page docs/axKit/components.md is written from this file by tools/components.ps1; tests/AxKit.Tests/ComponentsTests.cs holds the sources to it.

components.title: The list
components.what: Rows you move through with the arrow keys. Every list of every window is this one.
components.built in: Type the start of a name to jump to it; the edge sound at the first and the last row; rename in place with F2 where rows have names.
components.selection: With src/AxKit.Forms/ListSelection.cs: Space selects the row you are on, Shift with an arrow selects as it moves, Ctrl+A all, Escape none (SPEC AX-8.16). On in axFile's folder list, axTask's navigator and axMedia's queue so far.
components.says: NVDA reads the row; a selected row ends in ', selected'.

components.title: The text to read
components.what: Text you read and do not change: a conversation, a notice's text, a file shown read-only. The conversation's text is this class; a notice's text and a read-only file are the text box below, set read-only.
components.built in: The caret moves only on your own key. Letters jump by heading and the like; Ctrl+F finds.

components.title: The field
components.what: Text you type, on one line or several: a message, a command, a document, a name.
components.built in: Ctrl+Space switches between editing and navigating; a line break typed is said, 'new line'.
components.says: NVDA reads the field's name and what it holds.

components.title: The choice in the field's place
components.what: What a window waits on, shown where its field is: a list of answers, or a small field. Never a second window.
components.built in: The number keys choose an answer; Enter and Escape answer.
components.says: The question, then NVDA reads the answer you are on.

components.title: The form
components.what: Several standard controls for one action, in Tab order, each named with an instruction.
components.built in: Tab between the controls; Ctrl+Enter or Enter does it; Escape leaves and nothing is changed. Ctrl+Q reads its explanation.
components.says: After NVDA has read the first control: the title and the word 'form'.

components.title: The notice
components.what: A text with its buttons over the window: a help text, a question, an error. It holds one of the pieces above when it asks for more.
components.built in: Enter and Escape press its buttons from anywhere in it; Ctrl+Q reads its text again.

window types.title: The conversation window
window types.what: For something you talk to in turns: what was said above, and under it the field, or the choice that stands in its place. Over a program in a console (axClaude, axTerminal) the window is the console window, which adds the program to this shape.
window types.moving: Tab and the other pane keys switch between the text and the field. Escape in the text goes to the field. Enter on a line of the text takes it into the field.

window types.title: The editor
window types.what: For one text you write or read: the text, with a choice under it for Go to line and for the options of a place; read-only, a list of details under it.
window types.moving: Ctrl+Tab and F6 switch panes; Tab types a tab while editing.

window types.title: The navigator
window types.what: For things in levels: a list of rows you go into and out of, and beside it more of the row you are on.
window types.moving: Right goes into a row that holds a level; Left and Backspace go up. Enter opens the row. Tab and the other pane keys switch to the second pane; Escape comes back.

window types.title: The hotkey window
window types.what: For something called from anywhere in Windows with a key: a field that always holds the caret, and under it a list the arrow keys move through from the field.
window types.moving: Down and Up move through the list while you type. Enter does the app's thing with the row. Escape hides the window.
